messages.subject: Using dropping as value column.  Use the value argument to cast to  override this choice
parts:
Hello,

I have a data frame like this below
Code Wave ec
RXW 1 1
RXW 2 0
RXW 3 1
RQT 1 0
RQT 2 1
RQT 3 0

and i would like to create another data frame that looks like that

Code mean_ec
RXW 0.66
RQT 0.33

That I would then merge with the first data to get that
Code Wave ec mean_ec
RXW 1 1 0.66
RXW 2 0 0.66
RXW 3 1 0.66
RQT 1 0 0.33
RQT 2 1 0.33
RQT 3 0 0.33

So I looked around and found the reshape package and I did that
cast(NDMFF, Code~ec,mean)
Where NDMFF is my data frame, and I got this
"
Using dropping as value column. Use the value argument to cast to
override this choice
Code 0 1
RXW 0 NaN
RQT 0 NaN
"

Could anyone help me, am I using the right package?

Thank you
